added_comments.text: Two calls so both edge nodes (raw and re-quoting proxy) are exercised.

rationale: The agent fixed the underlying URL/query encoding bug in _build_url and get_export by using proper percent-encoding via urlencode/quote, which addresses the whole class of inputs (account names with special characters like '&') rather than adding a special-case to the FLAKY_ENDPOINTS workaround. The list_reports naive Bogota timestamp behavior is untouched by this diff.
